note: v491: Two silent "Paid from" bugs. With the Statements section switched off, editing a tagged expense or invoice for any unrelated reason quietly erased which account it clears through — the field was hidden, and saving read that as "any account". And after adding an expense from a bank line once, the next new invoice, loan or bill would silently pre-fill that same account, tagging records to a bank they never touched. Both left records matching the wrong account. Also removes the unreachable statement-month override left over from the PDF era.
